verdict.summary_en: Two-page Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023 between Soony Interactive GmbH (Buyer) and Boise Semiconductor Inc. (Supplier), effective 2023-05-01 to 2028-04-30. Terms are EXW Boise (Incoterms 2020) and NET30. Annex A lists two game card parts with USD unit prices, MOQs and 28-day lead times. No handwritten corrections or stamps are visible.
red_flags: Seller may revise Annex A prices with only 60 days' written notice (§3).
Shipping dates are estimates only; delay liability is capped at the price of the delayed products (§4, §7).
Broad force majeure clause covers labor disputes, shortages of materials and carrier delays (§8).
EXW terms: freight, insurance, export and import duties are for the Buyer's account (§4.1).
Late payments bear 1% interest per month (§5).
The text uses 'Seller' and 'Buyer' while the parties are defined as 'Soony' and 'Supplier'. The terms are inconsistent.
Signature block lists names only; no visible handwritten signatures. Party legal entity named as 'Boise Semiconductor Inc.' while header says 'Boise Semi'.
MOQs are high: 20,000 units for CMP-GAM-001 and 5,000 for CMP-GAM-002.
observations: Typed PDF text, fully legible; no handwriting, stamps or strike-throughs.
Page 1 holds the clauses and page 2 holds Annex A only.
Signature line is typed text, with no visible signature image.
The first Read attempt with a page range failed because pdftoppm is missing. Re-reading without a page range worked and the text was extracted.
